hypothesis: Do selective-capture peak-memory savings persist when both paths immediately release prefill outputs and concatenated features after conditioning?
scope: Synthetic document,480 or900 paragraphs; actual token counts recorded by tokenizer. Two repetitions with reversed method order. Same checkpoint and resident candidates for full-state and selective capture. Memory/trajectory diagnostic, not task quality or independent-sample inference. Lifetime control: both methods release prefill buffers after conditioning; this isolates retained-layer capture from avoidable decode-time prefill residency.
